name: org.tvevents/football-on-uk-tv
title: Football on UK TV
description: UK football kick-offs and TV listings by date, team or competition. Read-only.

tools.name: list_uk_football_tv
tools.description: Read UK TV and streaming listings for football on today, tomorrow, or an explicit UK date up to two days ahead. Optionally filter by team or competition. Returns kick-off times in Europe/London and listed UK broadcaster names. It does not determine subscriptions, show odds, or provide streams.

date.description: today, tomorrow, or an explicit YYYY-MM-DD in UK time. The latest supported date is two days ahead.

team.description: Optional full or partial team name, for example Aston Villa.

competition.description: Optional full or partial competition name, for example Champions League.
